name: Elemental Adept
desc: +1 Int, Wis or Cha. Choose an element: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder. Your spells ignore Resistance to that damage type, and when you roll its damage for a spell, a 1 on a die counts as a 2. You can take this feat more than once, choosing a different element each time.

effects.note: Your spells ignore Resistance to $choice damage; a 1 on their $choice damage dice counts as a 2
